description.value: Green Lake Station is a combined cafe and Chevron fuel stop near the north end of Whistler, making it a rare spot where both rider and vehicle can refuel in one stop. The kitchen turns out all-day breakfast, pizza, burgers, and paninis, with a menu broad enough to satisfy most dietary needs. Inside, a live-edge wooden communal table and a patio offer comfortable places to linger, and free Wi-Fi with ample outlets make it a practical mid-ride or end-of-day stop.
